filename_id_assessment.d6: Heavy_Equipment and mixer filename numbers behave like scraped-item indices, not trustworthy camera/sequence timestamps.
filename_id_assessment.d7: The seven-digit numeric token is useful as an identifier but is not reliably chronological: visually identical fixed-camera scenes recur at widely separated numbers. Sequence groups are therefore similarity-graph clusters, not groups invented from filename proximity alone.
